explanation: Compared against Theorem 1 of Dietmann–Elsholtz arXiv:1207.1461 (cited from erdosproblems.com/782): for N sufficiently large, a₀ ≥ 0, and A = {a₁,…,a_d} distinct positive integers with H(a₀; a₁,…,a_d) ⊆ S₂ ∩ [1,N], d ≤ 7 log log N. The Lean statement has ∃ N₀, ∀ N ≥ N₀, an injective positive b : Fin d → ℤ, 0 ≤ a₀, the cube contained in squares in [1,N], giving (d:ℝ) ≤ 7·log(log N). This matches exactly.
